messages:
marie: Quick heads-up: planning to enable catalog variant `redwood-titan-v2-quant` during tonight's change window (UTC 19:00-21:00). Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% with ~10m dwell. Also updating the catalog pinlist and fallback ordering. Please ack and call out any blockers.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by marie at 2026-03-20T19:08Z. Canary policy: waves=[5,25,50], dwell=10m, monitors=[latency,p95,p99,5xx,eval]. Auto-rollback hooks configured.

jake: ack. Quick Q: token-cost delta expected? Also worried about small-payload p99 due to quantized batching.

sasha: ack. Heads-up from solutions: enterprise customers with pinned variants may need a notification before their pinned variant changes. Can we flag customer-visible pin changes?

anita: ack. Fallback ordering for this rollout set to: 1) redwood-titan-v2-quant, 2) redwood-titan-v2-fp16, 3) redwood-titan-legacy-1.9. Fallback chooses closest memory-layout to avoid KV-cache churn. Session-pin rule: clients seeing >2x p99 regression get pinned to previous variant for 45m.

ben: rollback thresholds proposed: - 5xx >= 3% sustained for 10m -> trigger
- p99 increase > +60ms vs baseline for 10m -> trigger
- eval small-prompt-set quality regression > 2% absolute -> trigger
On trigger: 1) immediate switch traffic back to previous pinned variant, 2) abort remaining waves, 3) post incident stub and page oncall.

leon: ops items: bump KV eviction TTL on canary pools to 22m, enable cache-grace windows, and label canary nodes with `canary=true` so we can filter metrics. Also enabling extra debug logs for token-path.

clara: drafting release note now: "Enable redwood-titan-v2-quant in hosted catalog (canary -> enabled). Fallback ordering and rollback gates applied." Will post link in 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary wave 1 started -> 5% traffic (us-east-1). Monitoring dashboard: https://console/redwood/canaries/2030123456

jake: initial telemetry: p50 stable, p95 +8ms, p99 +20ms. No 5xx spike.

ben: confirm: alerts wired to pagerduty for severity >1. If gate trips I'll flip the circuit and notify #incidents.

anita: restricting wave 1 & 2 to us-east-1 only to reduce blast radius. Expanding to global only on green.

leon: KV TTL bumped to 22m for canary pools. Metrics streaming to `canary_stream`.

clara: release note published: https://docs.internal/releases/2030123456-redwood-titan-v2-quant. Changelog updated.

deploy-bot: Wave 2 scaled to 25% after dwell. Health: 5xx=0.18%, p99 +28ms, token-cost +2.7%.

jake: ran perf eval on small prompt set: quality delta -0.5%, within tolerance. Noting a tiny cohort of long sessions with p99 spikes; session-pin rule applied to those clients.

sasha: I've notified enterprise PMs about the catalog change and pinned-customer behavior. They asked to include a note in the release email about session pinning TTL.

ben: holding gate live. If p99 exceeds +60ms or 5xx >3% for 10m I will execute rollback. Also watching error-budget burn.

deploy-bot: Wave 3 -> scaled to 50%. Final monitor window open for 15m.

leon: enabling extended debug for token-streams; logs will be retained for 48h for the canary nodes.

marie: once final window is clean we'll mark variant enabled and leave it in the pinlist for gradual ramp outside change window. Ben will own rollback, Anita owns fallback config, Leon owns cache changes, Clara handles notes.

deploy-bot: Canary complete: no automatic rollback triggered. Variant state set: `enabled=true` in catalog for hosted. Deploy record: https://deploys.internal/2030123456

clara: scheduling 30-45m retro tomorrow to capture any adjustments to thresholds and pin TTLs. I'll add the enterprise notice to the release email drafts.

ben: will open a follow-up PR with suggested rollback threshold tweaks and add a larger eval run to the repo for future rollouts after reviewing full telemetry.

marie: thanks team. If anyone spots delayed regressions, post them here and we'll coordinate follow-up.
